title: Integrated In Silico Discovery of Thymoquinone Analogs Targeting the Keap1-Nrf2 Pathway for Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis Therapy.
authors: Nalicho, Jabir C; Mabeyo, Petro E; Paluch, Andrew S; Paul, Lucas
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过QSAR、对接和MD模拟发现靶向Keap1-Nrf2通路的胸腺醌类似物，但对象为蛋白-小分子互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，方法虽含AI和MD但与本课题TF-DNA结合机制无关。
abstract: Oxidative stress drives neuronal vulnerability in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), making the Keap1-Nrf2 pathway a vital therapeutic target. While thymoquinone (TQ) modulates this axis, its efficacy is limited by low potency and poor drug-likeness. We utilized an integrated in silico workflow-including validated QSAR modeling (R(2) = 0.68, Q(2) (ext) = 0.66), ADMET profiling, docking, 200 ns molecular dynamics, and MM-PBSA analysis-to identify improved TQ-derived Keap1 inhibitors. Screening 64 analogs prioritized three leads (CHEMBL3416163, CHEMBL4636830, and CHEMBL221598) with favorable safety and blood-brain barrier permeability. Docking and dynamics confirmed these analogs form stable interactions with Kelch domain hotspots. MM-PBSA calculations revealed significantly enhanced binding free energies (-75.10 to -93.79 kJ mol(-1)) compared to parent TQ (-21.05 kJ mol(-1)), driven primarily by van der Waals and hydrophobic forces. This study identifies structurally tractable TQ analogs with improved predicted potency and establishes a robust computational framework for neuroprotective discovery. The prioritized leads are compelling candidates for in vitro and in vivo validation as redox-modulating agents in ALS.
abstract_zh: 氧化应激驱动肌萎缩侧索硬化症（amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, ALS）中的神经元脆弱性，使Keap1-Nrf2通路成为重要的治疗靶点。尽管百里醌（thymoquinone, TQ）调节这一轴，但其疗效受限于低效力和较差的类药性。我们利用一个整合的计算机模拟工作流程——包括验证的QSAR建模（R(2) = 0.68, Q(2) (ext) = 0.66）、ADMET分析、对接、200 ns分子动力学（molecular dynamics）和MM-PBSA分析——来识别改进的TQ衍生Keap1抑制剂。筛选64个类似物优先选出三个先导化合物（CHEMBL3416163、CHEMBL4636830和CHEMBL221598），它们具有有利的安全性和血脑屏障通透性。对接和动力学分析确认这些类似物与Kelch结构域热点形成稳定相互作用。MM-PBSA计算显示，与母体TQ（-21.05 kJ mol(-1)）相比，结合自由能显著增强（-75.10至-93.79 kJ mol(-1)），主要由范德华力和疏水力驱动。本研究识别出结构可修饰且预测效力提高的TQ类似物，并为神经保护发现建立了稳健的计算框架。优先选出的先导化合物作为ALS中氧化还原调节剂，是体外和体内验证的有力候选者。
